svg.title: One worker, several assignments
svg.desc: A worker keeps its identity and conversation. Each assignment has a separate run.
svg.text: One worker, several assignments
A worker keeps its identity and conversation. Each assignment has a separate run.
RUN 1: DO THE FIRST TASK
Parent spawns a worker using a profile.
The worker saves conversation checkpoints.
MESSAGE WHILE RUNNING
New guidance waits for a supported boundary.
Accepted does not yet mean consumed.
RUN 2: FOLLOW UP WITH RETAINED CONTEXT
A follow-up queues behind Run 1; two runs never execute concurrently on one worker.
Hermes rechecks current tools, credentials, model route and limits before starting it.
OPTIONAL: A TREE OF WORKERS
An enabled coordinator can spawn children.
They share the assignment’s execution budget.
Depth, time, tool and concurrency limits apply.
Cancellation propagates to owned descendants.
PARENT GETS A COMPACT RESULT
Summary • status • usage • receipt reference
Inspect visible conversation only when needed.
Results remain pending until acknowledged.
Sibling messages require explicit policy.
Profile edits do not rewrite an existing worker’s original instructions.
A new root assignment gets a new budget; older descendants keep their earlier budget.
A cancellation request cannot prove an already-started external action stopped.
